ios.desc:
• #1 word game in 32 countries
• Played over 10 million times
• Four game modes, from frantic 30-second games to relaxed, untimed play
• 12 languages, each with its own full dictionary

Hexiled is an original word game played on a hexagon grid. Trace words through neighboring tiles: each word must touch an empty space on the board and be at least as long as the number shown on its tiles. The tutorial gets you started in a minute.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY

• ESCAPE - timing adapts to how well you play, so it's a frantic challenge at any level. A game takes a couple of minutes, or 15-30 seconds if you're really good.
• SURVIVE - every word earns you more time. A test of quick thinking, vocabulary and endurance that fits a 1-5 minute break.
• EXPLORE - no time limit. Relax and rack up a high score, or hunt for the longest words.
• DISCOVER - reach the edge of the board in as few words as possible. It gets harder as you get better.

PLAY IN 12 LANGUAGES

English, Français, Deutsch, Nederlands, Español, Português, Italiano, Svenska, Norsk, Dansk, Русский, Ελληνικά

Switch language any time. It's a great way to build vocabulary in a language you're learning.

ALSO INCLUDES

• Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• Detailed post-game stats and all-time records
• Color themes
• A killer original soundtrack
• Play offline, no account needed
• iPhone, iPad and Mac

Hexiled is free to play with ads. A one-time purchase removes ads and adds your Best Words list.

WHAT PLAYERS SAY

"The best word game I have ever played" - sboyce_tw
"One of the best games on the App Store - great word based game" - tcfairfax
"A very satisfying hexagonal word search maze-like. Highly recommend!" - BookishMatt
"This game is so amazing! I'm addicted to it" - jotap_rios
"Spellbinding new wordplay app" - Evaluapp

quotes.text:
Hi Chad, are you still playing all of your games yourself? I wonder if they are "sticky" enough? Bit hard to tell from the screen captures - they don't really stand out to me in the screenshots. But I like word games so will check out Letters!

While you got the OK for the Letterpress UI from the creator, I wonder if anyone else who's unaware of that would notice and think you're a clone and ignore you?

I released my first ever iOS game* last week and it's a word game like yours. Not sure if we (two man team) just got lucky, but overnight we hit millionth game played and we've hit #1 word game in 30 countries at one point or another. People are playing about 3-5 games per second at any given point of the day which amazes me. The game took us four months to make - a month on the core mechanic and the rest polishing.

I have a pipeline of game ideas I think are very good so definitely intend to make more.

* Our game: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/hexiled/id881274996?mt=8
